title: Dual modulation of coordination asymmetry and curvature unlocks record-level Zn–air battery performance with Fe–N–C single-atom catalysts
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,10390-10402
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04648C, Paper
Qichen Wang, Lulu Lyu, Nannan Han, Bingxian Chu, Chunyan Shang, Ziyi Wang, Hetong Pan, Dongjun Lee, Wang Zhang, Junfeng Zhang, Zhipeng Li, Wei Huang, Yong-Mook Kang
Dual modulation strategy of coordination asymmetry and curvature optimizes the atomic Fe sites, unlocking record-level quasi-solid-state Zn–air battery performance with a capacity of 1.56 Ah and cycling over 2000 h at −40 °C.
